categories.name: Murukku & Chakli Varieties
categories.description: Crunchy, spiral, and handcrafted traditional South Indian murukku treats.

items.name: Chettinad Kai Murukku
items.description: Authentic handcrafted rope-style murukku from Chettinad, twisted by hand for a superior crunch and traditional taste.
items.ingredients: Rice flour, Urad dal, Butter, Cumin, Pepper, Salt, Oil

items.name: Thenkulal Murukku (Plain)
items.description: A classic cylindrical spiral snack made with rice flour and urad dal, offering a light and crispy texture with a hint of cumin.
items.ingredients: Rice flour, Urad dal, Cumin, Salt, Veg Oil

items.name: Garlic Murukku (Plain)
items.description: Fragrant and flavorful murukku infused with the pungent aroma of fresh garlic, perfect for savory snack lovers.
items.ingredients: Rice flour, Garlic, Urad dal, Salt, Oil

items.name: Onion Murukku
items.description: Delicately flavored with the sweetness of fried onions, these murukkus provide a unique savory profile that's hard to resist.

items.name: Chettinad Mullu Murukku
items.description: Star-shaped, spiked murukku from the Chettinad region, known for its extreme crispiness and traditional spice blend.

items.ingredients: Gram flour, Peanuts, Cashews, Curry leaves, Chili, Salt

items.name: Sivakasi Special Mixture
items.description: The pride of Sivakasi, this mixture is uniquely spiced and balanced with a variety of crunchy elements for a festive feel.

items.name: Pallapatti Mixture
items.description: A traditional village-style mixture from Pallapatti, characterized by its rustic texture and authentic flavor.

items.description: A healthy alternative featuring foxtail millet and corn flakes, perfectly seasoned for a guilt-free crunch.

items.description: Authentic Puliyamarathadi Palkova from Srivilliputhur, made by slowly simmering pure milk until it reaches a rich, grainy texture.

items.description: Traditional ghee-based stick candy from Thoothukudi, loved for its nostalgic taste and rich aroma.

items.name: Ooty Varkey

items.description: Luxurious melt-in-the-mouth sweet made with pure ghee and gram flour, a Karnataka classic perfected by Tamil artisans.

items.name: Thaen Mittai
items.description: Nostalgic honey candy with a soft, syrup-filled center and a crispy sugar coating, bringing back childhood memories.
